name: Izolacja Jarocin Spolka Akcyjna
summary: IZOLACJA-JAROCIN SA engages in the production of waterproofing products and sealants for the construction industry. Its products include Asphalt felts, Bituminous roofing membranes and roofing felt for pitched roofs, and Asphalt masses. The firm also provides layered insulation covering systems. The company was founded in 1925 and is headquartered in Jarocin, Poland.
